summary: Diff introduces a pending-stories storage path, an admin moderation UI (pending + published tabs), and frontend hooks for admin publish/delete operations, plus migration support. However, key backend behaviors required by REQ-1/REQ-2/REQ-3 are not fully evidenced in the truncated backend diff, and several unrelated UI/theme/content changes were added that were not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Pending submissions must not appear in any public listing (feed/articles) until an admin publishes them.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows new pending storage (`pendingStories`) and `submitStory` writing to it, but does not show (in the provided/truncated backend diff) the public endpoints used by Feed/Articles filtering out pending stories or otherwise ensuring only published stories are returned.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin publishing must remove a submission from the pending list (no duplication) and error clearly if title is not pending.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls `actor.adminPublishStory(title)` and invalidates pending/published queries, but the provided backend snippet is truncated before showing `adminPublishStory` implementation, including (a) removal from `pendingStories` and (b) trapping/erroring when the title is not pending.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must expose an admin-only method to remove/unpublish a published story by title and reject non-admin callers with an Unauthorized error.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls `actor.adminDeletePublishedArticle(title)`, but the backend method implementation and its authorization checks are not shown in the truncated backend diff, so the required admin-only enforcement and Unauthorized error behavior are not evidenced.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin feature to create and publish a new article directly (not part of the requested approval/unpublish workflow).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asks for admin approval of user submissions and admin removal/unpublish by title; it does not request an admin ‘create article’ capability.

hallucinated_features.description: Global styling/theme overhaul to pastel/dark-blue token system and Tailwind theme changes.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any REQ; BuildRequest is about moderation workflow and unpublishing.

hallucinated_features.description: Home/About/Contact content and navigation changes unrelated to moderation workflow (e.g., creator bio, discuss section, caffeine.ai attribution).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any REQ; outside scope of admin approval/unpublish functionality.
Migration was not requested in the BuildRequest requirements/constraints; it may be useful, but it is an extra feature beyond the specified requirements.
